schema.description: Consultation / Procedures / Diagnostics / Pharmacy / Inpatient services
Approved / Denied / Pending / Under review / Appealed
Submitted / Under review / Approved / Denied / Paid / Appealed
Care / Facilities / Staff / Waiting / Billing / Other

bronze.notes: Values are preserved as raw strings. Type correction, null handling and de-duplication occur only in the silver layer.

scoring.method: severity-weighted rule ratios, then category-weighted mean
scoring.formula: score = SUM(weight_c * (SUM(sev_w * pass_ratio)/SUM(sev_w))) over categories; weights are normalised to sum to 1.0
